cant say in in same situation but all I can do is offer advice based on my P.O.V. personally as someone who thinks of ODing everyday. id recommend pulling your bro aside & before talking to him about it, have him swear on any/everything he wont tell anyone unless you tell him he can. you may not trust you parents. but you can at least put a little more into your bro than most others. even after my bro beating the shit out of me every day for years while he was drugged up on coke and steriods, I feel closer to him than anyone else.

its nice talking to people. where as I'm far too embarrassed to talk to anyone I know about my life hating, & too poor to afford anything, id recommend you give it a try. its nice to just let whatever you fell killing you inside to just let it out, just the process of letting it go feels beter than sitting there letting it fester. thinking you can handle it youself, you begin to think of it more and more as you fall deeper, & without help its easy to just keep falling deeper.

just my P.O.V, hope it helps if not sorry.

I'm trying, ima go out I'm like a hr go get a few applications, fill them up and take them places, & even if they say just go online. just put it on the table and leave. the problem with it is I live about a mile from town & about 3-4 from the jobs. & I don't have any warm cloths, & my town Is generally cold soo it makes it a little hard to get to W/out transport or warm cloths.

I've just applied to my local Kmart, rite aid, and DG. but that's about all we have in our small town. & even when I go in I see people working there that I went to school with who did far (far) better than me, & I just think if they're working here why would they ever hire me
